findingDetails.title: Continuity frontmatter was never refreshed when seven phase documents closed and the parent still sends a reader to phase 001
findingDetails.impact: Continuity-driven tooling reads completion_pct 0 on closed phases, and the parent's next_safe_action tells a reader to run a completed phase.
findingDetails.fixRecommendation: Refresh the continuity block of every closed phase and of the parent at closeout, or drop the block from documents the packet no longer drives.
